title: No slippage check when depositing to Pendle
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Low  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  When calling `YieldStrategy.depositToPendle()`, the slippage is set at zero when `router.swapExactTokenForPt()` is called.  ``` function depositToPendle(address _underlying, address _market, uint256 _amount)     external     returns (uint256)   {     (uint256 netPtOut,,) = router.swapExactTokenForPt(       address(this),       _market, >     0,       defaultApprox(),       createTokenInputStruct(_underlying, _amount),       emptyLimit()     );     return netPtOut;   } ```  This is the `swapExactTokenForPt` on the Pendle IPActi
